blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Workers who develop heat-related illnesses due to their working conditions may qualify for compensation under the Employees’ Compensation Program (ECP), under new guidelines issued by the Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) amid extreme heat conditions, including those associated with El Niño.
